note: A list period `[2016, 2019, 2020]` on `imp` (from 2018) is the requested days 2016 and 2019-2020 (reg-core merges the adjacent years). Fails if the binding stops giving one clip whose `requested` lists every requested piece and whose `ordered` holds only 2019-2020, if 2017-2018 is ordered or clipped (they were never requested), or if the clip stops being reported once as `period_clipped` over 2016.
